description: This PHP source file defines the class NameDeprecation within the Twig library, representing a deprecation notice for a named node or attribute. It contains properties for package, version, and new name, along with corresponding constructor and getter methods.

classes.name: NameDeprecation
classes.description: Represents a deprecation for a named node or attribute on a Node, including associated package, version, and new name information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a NameDeprecation instance with optional package, version, and new name strings.

methods.name: getPackage
methods.description: Returns the name of the package where the deprecation was introduced.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version in which the deprecation was introduced.

methods.name: getNewName
methods.description: Returns the recommended new name that replaces the deprecated name.
